entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order. I'd like to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 23rd. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh no, it works fine. It's really a matter of preference. I've just changed my mind about it. It was a bit of an impulse buy, and I find I just don't use it nearly as much as I thought I would.
I understand completely. Thank you for clarifying that. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold while I confirm the return eligibility for your order.

Thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your order details and our policy. I see you received the item 18 days ago, and our system confirms that items can be returned within 10 days of delivery. You're unfortunately outside that timeframe, so I cannot approve this return for a full refund.
Oh, that's fantastic news. I was a little worried I might be too late. I appreciate you checking that for me.

It's my pleasure. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just repackage the band in its original box and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That sounds simple enough. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
